_note: Hand-authored 2026-10-11 as a stand-in for the model-backed extractor: the producer is swappable, the citation contract is not. Every value carries the span that grounds it; quotes are sliced out of the span index programmatically rather than typed, because these documents contain non-breaking hyphens. Five pages, 103 spans -- the thinnest fixture in the set. Monthly managed services with hourly on-site support: continuous operations with a standing on-site element.
